pluginConfigFields.label: Engine binary
pluginConfigFields.help: Leave blank to use the engine built into this plugin (engine/build/engine). Set it to use a build of your own.

pluginConfigFields.label: Level offset
pluginConfigFields.help: Added to every reported amplitude, in dB. Use it to correct for feeder loss, an inline preamplifier or an attenuator.

pluginConfigFields.label: Simulate a radio (no hardware)
pluginConfigFields.help: Serves a synthetic UHF scene instead of opening a USRP. For trying the plugin out and for support diagnosis.

deviceConfigFields.label: Serial number
deviceConfigFields.help: The USRP's serial, as printed by `uhd_find_devices`. Leave blank when only one radio is attached.
